title: SiteManifest
description: Site-wide infrastructure defaults for MethylPipeline (genomes, caches, cluster settings). Not study-specific.

reference_selection.description: Pinned inventory paths under /work/genomes (and goliath/genomes/). Inventory may hold many versions; only these pins are active. Operators set this at site/cfg — not Python defaults.

linear.description: Relative path under genomes/ for the linear FASTA+indexes (e.g. linear/GRCh38/ensembl-116)

gene_annotation.description: Relative path under genomes/ for GENCODE GTF (e.g. annotation/gencode/v50)

pangenome.description: Relative path under genomes/ for the Giraffe bundle (e.g. pangenome/GRCh38/d9/1.70)

pangenome_genome.description: Stock HPRC / vg Giraffe pangenome graph bundle (surjected to linear_ref_fasta). Not bisulfite-aware; use pangenome_wgbs_genome / actionConfig.methylgrapher_wgbs for WGBS.

ref_paths.description: Path to GRCh38 ref-paths file for surjection

linear_ref_fasta.description: Linear GRCh38 FASTA matching ref_paths (used by collectmultiplemetrics and MethylExtractor)

pangenome_wgbs_genome.description: methylGrapher C2T/G2A bisulfite pangenome bundle (QNAP asset pangenome-grch38-d9-bs-1.70). Prefer baking paths into actionConfig.methylgrapher_wgbs for workers.

rna_reference.description: RNA-Seq reference assets for the transcriptomics process pack. STAR index + GTF feed pbrun rna_fq2bam; the kallisto index feeds pbrun kallisto. Operators pin these at site/cfg, not in Python.

star_index_dir.description: Directory containing a STAR genome index (used by pbrun rna_fq2bam)

gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF for STAR gene counts / feature assignment

reference_fasta.description: Genome FASTA matching the STAR index

kallisto_index.description: Path to a prebuilt kallisto transcriptome index (.idx)

transcriptome_fasta.description: Transcriptome FASTA used to build the kallisto index

tx2gene.description: Optional transcript-to-gene map (TSV) for aggregating kallisto transcript abundances to genes

proteomics_reference.description: Proteomics reference assets for the mass-spec process pack. protein_fasta + spectral_library feed DIA-NN; prosit_model / casanovo_model pin DL weights (as cfg reference_assets). Operators pin these at site/cfg, not in Python.

protein_fasta.description: Protein sequence FASTA for DIA-NN search / library-free prediction

spectral_library.description: DIA spectral library (.tsv/.speclib) for DIA-NN; omit for library-free

prosit_model.description: Pinned Prosit model weights path (rescoring / in-silico library)

casanovo_model.description: Pinned Casanovo model weights path (de novo)

actionConfig.description: Optional per-action defaults keyed by catalog action_config_key. QC slices use the site full-guardrails type; other keys remain free-form.

testing.description: Optional TestDataRegistry: designated real reference samples per analyte and named groups for @pytest.mark.real_data tests. See schemas/config/test_data_registry.schema.json and docs/reference/test-data-registry.md.

samples.description: Reference samples keyed by analyte or logical name (e.g. cfdna, buffy_coat).

groups.description: Named cohorts keyed by group name (e.g. healthy, PCa).
